summary: Opened a new investigation into the sharded log-db write path: step workers route clusters by clusterID % Engine.ExecShards while ShardedDB routes by (clusterID % LogDB.Shards) % ExecShards, and nothing in NodeHostConfig.Validate relates the two counts, so an accepted expert configuration (4/6) puts cluster ids 1 and 9 in one step bucket but different log-db partitions, where getParititionID panics 'multiple pid value found' inside the unrecovered step worker. Submitted 13 source anchors (engine routing, both partitioners, ShardedDB save path, config validation) plus a source-grounded behavior record, and requested execution of TestAssuranceLogDBShardRouting, which reports config acceptance, the routing of ids 1, 7 and 9, and the outcomes of a single-cluster, a same-partition and a mixed-partition SaveRaftState batch. The defect account, its process-termination consequence and any interpretation remain pending that receipt; the earlier witness-flag finding is unchanged.
